# Coding Guidelines

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### 1. Formatting via Pint + EditorConfig

- Run `vendor/bin/sail bin pint --dirty --format agent` after PHP edits; enforced by Laravel Pint v1.32.1 with defaults (no `pint.json`) — `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`.
- UTF-8, LF, 4-space indent, final newline, trim trailing whitespace (not in `*.md`); YAML 2 spaces except `compose.yaml` 4 — enforced by `.editorconfig`.
- No ESLint, Prettier or PHPStan config in repo. Frontend type safety enforced by `vue-tsc --noEmit` (`package.json` `typecheck`).

### 2. Lookup rows resolved by slug, never by id

- Categorical values live in 15 lookup tables extending `app/Models/LookupModel.php`; each model exposes slug constants (`TaskStatus::RUNNING`, `ApprovalStatus::PENDING`).
- Write `TaskStatus::idFor(TaskStatus::QUEUED)`; `idFor` caches slug → id per process and throws `ModelNotFoundException` on unknown slug.
- Seen in `TaskService`, `ApprovalService`, `ToolExecutor`, `CostLimitGuard`, `ConversationMessageController`.

### 3. Owner authorization via Policies + `Gate::authorize`

- 8 policies use `App\Policies\Concerns\AuthorizesOwner::owns()` (`user_id` comparison).
- Controllers call `Gate::authorize('view', $model)` (e.g. `ConversationController`); base `App\Http\Controllers\Controller` is empty (no `AuthorizesRequests` trait); FormRequests authorize via `$this->user()->can(...)` (`StoreMessageRequest`).
- Queries filter by `user_id`; realtime goes to `private-user.{id}` only (`routes/channels.php`). Cross-user matrix covered by `tests/Feature/CrossUserIsolationMatrixTest.php`.

### 4. Eager load everything; lazy loading throws

- `Model::preventLazyLoading(! $this->app->isProduction())` in `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php`.
- Listings use `->with([...])` (`ConversationController`, `ActivityController`); query budget asserted by `tests/Concerns/CountsQueries.php` / `QueryBudgetTest`.

### 5. Untrusted tool content always wrapped

- Tool, connector and delegation output passes through `App\Support\UntrustedContent::wrap()` / `wrapJson()` before a model sees it.
- Used in `HttpToolHandler`, `McpToolHandler`, `ToolResult`, `ToolAdapter`, `DelegationService`, `AgentRuntimeFactory`, `BrainClient`. Covered by `PromptInjectionTest`, `UntrustedContentTest`.

### 6. Services with promoted readonly dependencies

- Domain logic lives in `app/Services/*` classes injected through constructors: `public function __construct(private readonly Settings $settings, private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}` (`ApprovalService`, `TaskService`, `MemoryService`, `ToolExecutor`).
- Typed class constants (`public const string QUEUE = 'tasks';`, `public const array INTENTS`) — `RunTask`, `IntentRouter`, `Settings`.
- Explicit return types and PHPDoc array shapes (`@return array{intent: string, agent: string|null, ...}`) — `IntentRouter`, `ResultNormalizer`.

### 7. Validation in FormRequests, output via API Resources

- One FormRequest per write endpoint under `app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/<Area>/` (e.g. `StoreMemoryRequest`, `UpdatePreferencesRequest`).
- Responses wrap `app/Http/Resources/*Resource` (16 classes); lookups exposed as slugs, timestamps as ISO 8601 (`toIso8601String()`).

### 8. Laravel 13 model attributes

- Mass assignment declared with `#[Fillable([...])]` on 23 models (e.g. `LookupModel`); scopes with `#[Scope]`.
- Secrets use `encrypted` casts: `AiProvider.api_key`, `McpServer.credential`, `Tool.credential`.

### 9. Runtime tunables through `Settings`, not config literals

- Limits/timeouts/thresholds read via `App\Support\Settings` typed getters (`taskTimeoutSeconds()`, `memoryTopN()`), cached per key; ranges in `Settings::RANGES`; edits audited as `setting_updated`.

### 10. User-facing text in pt-BR

- Notifications, errors and delegation results use pt-BR strings (`ApprovalService`, `DelegationService`, `CostLimitGuard`); translations in `lang/pt_BR`, SPA `resources/js/i18n/pt-BR.json`.

### 11. Commands always via Sail, tests filtered

- `vendor/bin/sail test --filter=Name`; new tests `vendor/bin/sail artisan make:test --phpunit` (`AGENTS.md`, `README.md`). Generator stubs customized in `stubs/` (agent, structured-agent, agent-middleware, tool).
